description: This Java class `ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategy` implements a substitution strategy for policy entries within a `ModifyPolicyEntries` command, specifically handling the substitution of subject IDs within policy entries.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a substitution strategy for `ModifyPolicyEntries`, focusing on substituting policy entries with respect to headers and other placeholders.

methods.name: ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the substitution strategy for `ModifyPolicyEntries` class.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substitution to the provided `ModifyPolicyEntries` object using the given substitution algorithm, returning either the original or a new `ModifyPolicyEntries` object with substituted entries.
